provenance.method: CEM direct win-rate optimization in training-only RMS coordinates; distinct from supervised cross-entropy fitting.
provenance.description: Natural-unit search coefficients retained by a fresh W0 comparison. Predictive calibration is reported separately.
provenance.gamesMeaning: Completed candidate, checkpoint and final comparison matches, including rejected and incomplete-iteration candidates. Candidates share board seeds; this count is not a unique-seed count or a training-corpus size.

supervisedFit.reason: The candidate did not pass the fresh W0 strength comparison.

coordinateScales.normalization: Per-feature RMS from training games only; used for Gaussian CEM exploration. Exported coefficients remain in natural units.

configuration.name: Aeneas
configuration.description: Position evaluation with deterministic turn planning.

strengthTuning.selectionCriterion: Candidate training matches and checkpoint gates only. Ship the last accepted checkpoint only if a fresh 600-game W0 gate has Wilson 95% lower bound above 1/3; otherwise retain W0.
strengthTuning.checkpointCriterion: 600 complete fresh games, point win rate above 1/3; failed gates revert and shrink exploration. This is distinct from the stronger final Wilson criterion.
strengthTuning.commonSeedsCaveat: Candidates in an iteration share seeds. Completed candidate matches are distinct matches, but unique seeds are fewer and candidate fitness estimates are correlated.
strengthTuning.initialization: W0; the supervised coefficient candidate did not pass its strength comparison.

postSelectionPredictionDiagnostic.limitation: Exploratory off-policy W0 holdout evaluated after coefficient selection; correlated observations do not establish calibrated probabilities or improved playing strength.

budgetSelection.interpretation: Fixed-work search configuration selected using latency and point wins. Paired planner differences include zero; final arena measurements use separate seeds.
